verdict.rationale: The docs say you can ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, and MCP lets you connect external tool servers, explicitly including issue trackers, alongside hundreds of other tools. ClickUp and Monday.com are never named, so they appear reachable only through generic MCP wrapping. Nothing shows agents actually managing tickets (creating them, updating status, commenting) or how a native integration is set up. Missing for 10: explicit ClickUp/Monday.com integrations, documented setup and ticket-management actions for Jira/Linear, independent hands-on corroboration.
